text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer kept having recurring 
nightmares about Sakura Laurel breaking 
down overseas.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fear of injury grew day by day, and 
even on the day of her Debut race, they 
couldn't help but worry and tell her not 
to push herself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel, on the other hand, 
admonishes her Trainer not to desperately 
cling to fear. Because what she wanted 
wasn't for her Trainer to protect her—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...Because she wants them to dream 
together with her. As if brushing aside 
the anxiety surrounding her Trainer, 
Sakura Laurel courageously heads toward 
her debut race."
